g.text: loop: each compiled protocol slot (all live debates batched)
sync_sampler() — sampler now serves last step's weights
build DebateStates: bindings per speaker, group ids (task, arm, seat)
trained seat: Policy.predict -> backend.sample (Datum born here, advantages zeroed)
parse verdict (grammar-forced JSON) -> ladder + shaping -> one Trajectory per trained seat
family.grade(meta, solution) -> solution_correct metric (info only, never reward)
grpo_pack: center rewards per group, fill advantages, drop zero-variance
optim_step() -> new weights (picked up by next sync_sampler)
